name: whoami
description: Show the authenticated user.

name: show_session
description: Show how long the current session stays valid.

name: close_sessions
description: Sign this account out everywhere: every session of the account is closed and must log in again, and every app or agent connected over MCP loses access.

name: update_profile
description: Update your profile.

name: update_profile_learning_data
description: Replace your learning-progress data.

name: list_mcp_connections
description: List the apps and agents you authorized to use your account over MCP. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page.

name: revoke_mcp_connection
description: Revoke an app or agent connection; it loses access to your account at once.

name: list_datasets
description: List the datasets you can use: your PRIVATE datasets plus every PUBLIC one (user_id is each owner's id); your datasets under review are not listed. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page.

name: show_dataset
description: Show one dataset, yours or any PUBLIC one, with a download link to its file.

name: create_dataset
description: Create a dataset from a local file: the file is described, registered and uploaded.

name: update_dataset
description: Change one of your datasets' description and tags. Replaces both: an omitted one is cleared.

name: delete_dataset
description: Delete one of your datasets.

name: publish_dataset
description: Ask for one of your datasets to be reviewed for publication.

name: list_processors
description: List the data synthesis processors you can use: every PUBLIC one plus the HIDDEN ones you created. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page.

name: show_processor
description: Show one processor, any PUBLIC one or one you created, and its parameters.

name: list_processing
description: List the processing runs you can see: your own and every PUBLIC one (user_id is each owner's id). Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page.

name: show_processing
description: Show one processing run, yours or any PUBLIC one, including its status, its dataset and processor, and the download links of its result and metrics files.

name: run_processing
description: Start a processing run of a dataset with a processor.

name: delete_processing
description: Delete one of your processing runs.

name: extend_processing
description: Keep the files of a processing run until a later date.

name: set_processing_visibility
description: Make a processing run private or public.

name: estimate_processing_time
description: Estimate a processing run's duration before starting it, given a dataset and a processor.

name: estimate_processing_finish
description: Estimate when an in-progress processing run will finish.

name: health_check
description: Check that the AutoDroid API answers (returns its clock).

name: health_liveness
description: Check that the AutoDroid API process is alive.

name: health_readiness
description: Check that the AutoDroid API and the services it depends on are ready.

name: admin_list_datasets
description: List every dataset across all users. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page. Requires admin access.

name: admin_show_dataset
description: Show one dataset, owned by any user. Requires admin access.

name: admin_update_dataset
description: Change any dataset's description and tags. Replaces both: an omitted one is cleared. Requires admin access.

name: admin_set_dataset_visibility
description: Change any dataset's visibility. Requires admin access.

name: admin_delete_dataset
description: Delete any dataset. Requires admin access.

name: admin_list_processors
description: List every processor, including non-public ones. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page. Requires admin access.

name: admin_show_processor
description: Show one processor with its whole definition, including non-public ones. Requires admin access.

name: admin_create_processor
description: Create a processor. Requires admin access.

name: admin_update_processor
description: Replace a processor's whole definition with the given one; an omitted description or tags is cleared. Requires admin access.

name: admin_delete_processor
description: Delete a processor. Requires admin access.

name: admin_list_processing
description: List every processing run across all users. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page. Requires admin access.

name: admin_show_processing
description: Show one processing run, owned by any user. Requires admin access.

name: admin_update_processing
description: Change any processing run's keep-until moment and, optionally, its visibility. Requires admin access.

name: admin_delete_processing
description: Delete any processing run. Requires admin access.

name: admin_clean_expired_processing
description: Permanently remove every expired processing run. Requires admin access.

name: admin_estimate_processing_time
description: Estimate processing durations for a dataset and/or a processor (all combinations when omitted). Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page. Requires admin access.

name: admin_fail_dangling_processing
description: Mark processing runs left dangling (not progressing) as failed. Without filters, fails the PENDING runs created more than one day ago. Requires admin access.

name: admin_list_workers
description: List every registered worker across all users. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page. Requires admin access.

name: admin_show_worker
description: Show one registered worker. Requires admin access.

name: admin_update_worker
description: Change a worker's description or tags. Requires admin access.

name: admin_delete_worker
description: Delete a worker. Requires admin access.

name: admin_clean_missing_workers
description: Remove every worker that stopped reporting. Requires admin access.

name: admin_list_worker_registration_tokens
description: List the worker registration tokens, without their values. Returns one page: items, total_count (how many match in all) and has_next_page. Requires admin access.

name: admin_show_worker_registration_token
description: Show one worker registration token, including its value. Requires admin access.

name: admin_create_worker_registration_token
description: Create a worker registration token and show its value. Requires admin access.

name: admin_delete_worker_registration_token
description: Delete a worker registration token; its value is not shown. Requires admin access.

name: admin_remove_dangling_files
description: Permanently remove every stored file that no dataset or processing run uses. Requires admin access.
